speaker: Narrator
text: The courier was due at the garrison at noon. It is now dusk.

speaker: Captain Ilse
text: "Our courier never arrived," Captain Ilse says. "He was carrying the treaty. Someone has to find him before the pass snows shut."

speaker: Rook
text: "I'll ride at first light," Rook promises. "I'll bring him back, or the treaty at least."
